text:
On October 22 Atlas adds CSV exports to the Team plan. The plan is $19 per seat per month and each export can hold up to 50,000 rows. Your existing API limits stay the same. You get the exports on top of what you already have. That should keep your current workflows from getting in the way.

You don't need to change anything to use them. The exports just plug into the tools you are already running. If your team has been working around the old limits this takes that workaround off the table.
